answer: Computational proof-of-work resists Sybil attacks by requiring a unique cryptographic puzzle for each registration. An attacker cannot spawn fakes because every identity demands 50 GPU-hours of energy. To navigate this ocean, each proof is verified on-chain. Even a violet agent must contribute work; no ledge exists to skip the hardware requirement. Costs scale linearly with every fake, ensuring that identity duplication is financially ruinous. This prevents mass forgery through high electricity costs.
